requests.name: act_full_belly_refuse_water
requests.why: 🔁 다시 뽑기(2026-09-25): 첫 클립은 물을 여러 모금 마셔서 대사('배가 늘 부르니 물을 덜 마시게 돼요')와 반대로 읽힌다 — 컵을 입에 대지 않고 내려놓게 고쳤다. 3번 행('배가 늘 부르니 물을 덜 마시게 돼요. 그만큼 한 번 더 굳어요')의 행위 클립. 라이브러리에 '물을 마시려다 배가 불러 내려놓는' 동작이 없다 — act_drink_caffeine은 끝까지 들이켜고 마지막에 뇌가 점등해 반대 뜻(잘 마심)이 되고, act_nausea_push_plate_away는 음식 그릇을 밀어내는 메스꺼움 동작이라 이 행의 말(물을 덜 마심)과 어긋난다. 물컵을 입까지 올렸다가 한 모금만 대고 배를 쓸며 도로 내려놓고, 몸속에선 가득 찬 위 아래로 대장이 말라 굳어가는 게 보여야 한다.
requests.midjourney: Medical holographic visualization of a single translucent glass-like human figure seated on a plain low stool, every structure rendered in the same soft pale cyan glow, dark empty slate blue-grey void, cinematic soft rim lighting, vertical 9:16 portrait frame, smooth featureless face, seated body visible from the top of the head to the feet. The figure holds a plain tall glass of clear water of the same translucent cyan glass in one hand just below the chin, the head tilted slightly away from it, while the other flat palm rests on the upper belly just below the ribs. --ar 9:16 --no text, letters, numbers, labels, arrows, watermark, logo, UI, interface, amber, orange, red, blood colour, opaque skin, clothing, hair, facial features, table, cutlery, machine parts, duplicated limbs
requests.flow: One continuous shot in a single unbroken scene with no scene cuts, the camera holding on the seated figure and easing slowly in toward the torso. 0-1.5s: from the very first frame the stomach is already glowing a steady amber, full and rounded, and the figure lifts the glass of water only as far as just below the chin. 1.5-3s: the glass stops there and never touches the lips; the figure turns the head slightly away from it while the free hand presses flat on the upper belly and the shoulders rise as if the stomach is already too full. 3-4.5s: the figure lowers the glass straight back down to the lap untouched, the water level exactly the same as at the start, and below the glowing stomach the large intestine framing the lower belly begins to light amber in dense beaded clumps. 4.5-6s: the full glass rests in the lap, the hand stays on the belly, and the beaded clumps inside the large intestine tighten and throb intense amber twice, staying fully lit until the very last frame, while every other organ, every bone and the glass skin stay soft pale cyan. The figure never drinks and never tilts the glass; no water leaves the glass at any moment. The body stays translucent glass with all organs visible inside throughout; the face stays smooth and featureless. The dark slate blue-grey void stays empty. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows anywhere in the frame. The audio is a low synth hum, one quiet glass tap as it lowers, two deep heartbeat thumps with the throbbing, no music, no dialogue.
